explanation: Kenya's Maasai Mara is the northern end of the same ecosystem, and the great herds cross between the two countries every year.

claims.text: The Serengeti lies mostly in Tanzania.
The Serengeti does not lie mainly in Kenya, Uganda or Zambia.
Kenya's Maasai Mara is the northern part of the Serengeti ecosystem.
The wildebeest migration crosses between Tanzania's Serengeti and Kenya's Maasai Mara each year.
